import sys

def find_dominant_piranha(n, a):
    for i in range(n):
        if (i == 0 and a[i] > a[i + 1]) or \
           (i == n - 1 and a[i] > a[i - 1]) or \
           (0 < i < n - 1 and a[i] > a[i - 1] and a[i] > a[i + 1]):
            return i + 1
    return -1

    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read

    index += 1
    results = []

        index += 1
        a = list(map(int, data[index:index + n]))
        index += n
        result = find_dominant_piranha(n, a)
        results.append(result)
    
    for result in results:
